items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: I know him when he was around here. When he first went around here trying to play around here.

ctx.x: Sure. No, I know him when he was around here. When he first went around here trying to play around here. He was playing George Fewclothes on Franklin and, uh, me and Franklin and Neighborville, which used to be Franklin and Custom House. Mm-hmm. Right across from 25. George Fewclothes.
